title: Deeper/broader SPLINE diagnostic and 3D projection route refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Reconcile open ACadSharp DWG-to-DXF spline and whole-file acceptance reports with Autodesk DXF semantics
Characterize the current GDAL DXF route's projection limits for SPLINE and 3D modeler entities
Refine existing PAR-22 and PAR-07/S8 comparator gates without adding fixtures or dependencies

method.kind: Read-only review of current public issue/documentation/source pages and local plan owners
method.limitations: Issue #1299 supplies no published offending spline arrays, handle, exact GDAL diagnostic/options, or independent expected curve; its attachment and linked AI explanation were not reviewed. GDAL mutable stable documentation/master source describes its current route, not an independently executed result.

sources.revision: Public issue pages reviewed 2026-10-18; #1299 names NuGet v3.8.0, #1297 names master v3.8.14 and v3.8.0
sources.observed: The still-open #1299 report says an AutoCAD-authored DWG converted by ACadSharp to DXF yields SPLINE data rejected by GDAL during GeoJSON conversion, but publishes no offending entity handle, ordered arrays, exact GDAL diagnostic/options, or independent curve expectation. The still-open #1297 reports whole-file AutoCAD 2025 rejection for an AC1032 MTEXT frame-only flag case while 0x11 and AC1027 cases reportedly open; its proposed missing-style cause is unproved.
The SPLINE reference distinguishes degree 71, knot count/values 72/40, control count/points 73/10/20/30, optional fit count/points 74/11/21/31, weights 41, and optional WCS start/end tangents.

sources.revision: Stable documentation and mutable master source reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The driver projects SPLINE as a tessellated LINESTRING and documents eight output vertices per control point. It can expose entity handles and optional raw code values. By default it skips 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE; optional AC1027+ DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASM data and a transform but does not construct OGR solid geometry.

sources.revision: Working tree at baseline commit de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
sources.observed: The plan already assigns generated field/curve validation to PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB and modeler carrier/semantic separation to PAR-07/S8. The update adds only route-specific comparator interpretation and focused readiness.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies that GDAL's spline tessellation is diagnostic/projection evidence, not an exact NURBS oracle; separates whole-file DWG acceptance and raw ASM transport from B-rep semantics. All work stays under existing owners and gates.

implementationReadyChecks: On any touched local spline path, use small generated positive/negative cases in the existing owner and assert ordered fields, independently computed curve sentinels, refusal or diagnostics, and next-record alignment.
Pin GDAL version/options at the existing composed checkpoint; record status, diagnostics, source/output hashes, per-handle disposition, optional raw tag observations, and feature counts.
Do not equate GDAL's eight-vertices-per-control-point spline projection with the source curve definition or infer semantic correctness from successful projection.
Treat GDAL's AC1027+ raw ASMData/ASMTransform route as carrier observation only, not solid decoding or ACIS/B-rep semantic qualification.
Do not download issue/customer drawings or add fixtures, dependencies, CTest registrations, or per-slice full-suite runs.
